'''2007 North Dakota State Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event held on 28 July 2007 at Paradox Cards N Comics in Fargo, North Dakota, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS12]]).<ref name="sf-15981-218657">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=218657#p218657 North Dakota States 2007 - 7/28/07], The Smoking Gungan (Brian Herold), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 July 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126052707/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=15981 Internet Archive]</ref> Seven players competed; [[Michael Raveling]] finished first in the Swiss rounds and defeated [[Peter Jacobson]] in the final confrontation.<ref name="sf-15981-220644">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=220644#p220644 North Dakota States 2007 - 7/28/07], The Smoking Gungan (Brian Herold), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (28 July 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126052707/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=15981 Internet Archive]</ref> The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2007 North Dakota State Championship.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]] ([[Virtual Set 13]] was not yet legal)<ref name="sf-15981-218657" />
* '''Site:''' Paradox Cards N Comics, 26 Roberts Street, Fargo, North Dakota<ref name="sf-15981-218657" />
* '''Dates:''' 28 July 2007 (11:00 am start)<ref name="sf-15981-218657" />
* '''Format:''' Swiss, Open Format (all sets and virtual cards legal except [[Virtual Set 13]]), six games plus a final confrontation between the top two players<ref name="sf-15981-218657" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5 to $10 (announced as TBD between $5 and $10)<ref name="sf-15981-218657" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Brian Herold]] (also served as active judge)<ref name="sf-15981-218657" /><ref name="sf-15981-220667">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=220667#p220667 North Dakota States 2007 - 7/28/07], Jeeps (Peter Jacobson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 July 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126052707/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=15981 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Raveling]]<ref name="sf-15981-220644" />
* '''Runner-up:''' [[Peter Jacobson]] (received the [[2007 World Championship]] Day 2 bye because Raveling already held a bye from Bespin Regionals)<ref name="sf-15981-220644" />

== Results ==

Seven players competed. [[Michael Raveling]] placed first in the Swiss rounds and defeated second-place [[Peter Jacobson]] in the final confrontation. Because Raveling already held a [[2007 World Championship]] Day 2 bye from Bespin Regionals, the bye went to Jacobson.<ref name="sf-15981-220644" />
